value.answer: Sorry you're going through this. The free option is Ontario Structured Psychotherapy (OSP): free CBT for adults with depression or anxiety, no health card or doctor's referral needed, and you can refer yourself at ontariohealth.ca/osp. It's virtual, by phone, or in person. It's not right for every situation, so if your needs are more complex it may not fit. If you'd rather pay, Affordable Therapy Services has online sessions from about $50 on a sliding scale, and Get Reconnected has student-intern sessions around $45. I couldn't confirm current openings, so check before you book. What's bringing you to look for someone? That would help me point you to the best fit.
